hack.root_cause: Forged cross-chain message via LayerZero EndpointV2 lzReceive — exploitation of 1/1 DVN (single-validator) configuration
hack.description: An attacker forged a single LayerZero message to drain $292M in rsETH from Kelp DAO's mainnet bridge reserve, then weaponized the unbacked tokens as Aave collateral to borrow $196M in ETH — all inside the 46-minute window before Kelp could pause.
